newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks bob higher in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks bob higher in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks bobbed marginally higher in early morning trade on Thursday, recovering slightly from the previous day's profit-taking, brokers said.
There were no especially depressing factors for the market and the index was fairly firm, the brokers added.
At 0018 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 was up 53.90 points or 0.26 percent at 21,033.34. Its December futures were up 30 points at 21,090.
"There isn't much to push the Nikkei 225 out of the box its stuck in, so its gathering up energy to either jump or fall," one broker at a middle-sized brokerage said.
